mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_knowledge_base (user_id, name, description, embedding_model) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{embeddingModel})
mapper.sql: SELECT k.id, k.user_id, k.name, k.description, k.embedding_model, k.status, k.create_time, k.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_document d WHERE d.knowledge_base_id = k.id) AS document_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.chunk_count) FROM sa_document d WHERE d.knowledge_base_id = k.id), 0) AS chunk_count FROM sa_knowledge_base k
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_knowledge_base SET name = #{name}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sa_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
